Spotify album information

Source: R/api-access.R
get_spotify_album_tracks.Rd

Access the Spotify API to get a track listing for an album.

Usage

get_spotify_album_tracks(album_id, api_key = get_spotify_access_token())

Arguments

album_id

The Spotify ID for an album.

api_key

A Spotify access token, from get_spotify_access_token().

Value

A tibble with containing the track listing with 1 row per track:

  • track_name: The name of the track.

  • track_uri: The Spotify track ID.

See also

Other API access: get_reccobeats_audio_features(), get_soundstat_audio_features(), get_spotify_track_info()

Examples

# 1989 (Taylor's Version)
get_spotify_album_tracks(album_id = "1o59UpKw81iHR0HPiSkJR0")
